title: Lower bounds on the strength of the determinant
summary: We establish new lower bounds for the strength and partition rank of the determinant. For every prime $p$, we prove the exact identity \[ \operatorname{str}(\mathrm{det}_p)=p. \] A weak monotonicity argument, combined with a bound for gaps between consecutive primes, then gives $\operatorname{str}(\mathrm{det}_n)\ge (1-o(1))n^{0.475}$ for sufficiently large $n$. Since the Birch rank of $\mathrm{det}_n$ is always $4$, this gives the first explicit family showing that the dependence on the degree in bounds for strength in terms of Birch rank is unavoidable.
